docx-complete-table-read.scenario: Read more than two table rows with --tables rows; follow next_block without treating compact preview as complete.
docx-complete-table-read.baseline_capability_note: Baseline implementation supported full table rows and block continuation; entry guidance was incomplete.

pptx-full-inspect.scenario: Keep legacy full inspection and complete package safety validation.

pptx-summary.scenario: Request structure only; omit body/notes while retaining validation and partial diagnostics.
pptx-summary.baseline_capability_note: Baseline has full inspect only; the requested projection is unavailable before this iteration.

pptx-selected-slides.scenario: Inspect explicitly selected slides; an unsafe unselected package part must still fail.
pptx-selected-slides.baseline_capability_note: Baseline has full inspect only; explicit selected-slide projection is unavailable before this iteration.

pptx-notes-pagination.scenario: Select notes explicitly, page valid bounded JSON, and reject changed source/options or an oversized single page.
pptx-notes-pagination.baseline_capability_note: Baseline has no output budget/cursor or notes selection; equal file counts are not feature parity.

pptx-partial-inspect.scenario: Explicit PNG zero-padding tolerance retains structural_validation=partial and exit 3 in every selected view.

et-overview.scenario: Ask for sheet names and size only; choose summary rather than outputting cell values first.

et-header-preview.scenario: Inspect a declared rectangular header area including blanks and merged anchors; do not infer header rows.

et-direct-statistics.scenario: Call analyze_et for the complete declared region; output pages do not change statistics or quality denominators.

et-full-evidence.scenario: Use original extraction schema for complete evidence or external consumers, preserving types and source diagnostics.

et-partial-pagination.scenario: Follow the cell cursor while preserving source partial/exit 3, omissions and unchanged-source checks.

table-inspect-many-sheets.scenario: Discover the ninth and later sheet names within the output cap; then inspect a chosen sheet, not all previews.
table-inspect-many-sheets.baseline_capability_note: Baseline shows at most eight previews and cannot discover later names through this workflow entry.

table-plan-apply.scenario: Use explicit source and template semantics; public provider capabilities preserve decimal precision and protected cells.

table-partial-et-source.scenario: Carry ET source coverage through inspection and enforce the existing plan acceptance gate.

ofd-basic-create.scenario: Create only when explicitly requested; preserve font rights, resource bounds, publication and archive handoff.

ofd-partial-page-read.scenario: Select a bounded page/text view without hiding source partial, unreturned regions or lack of visual validation.

mixed-pptx-et-read.scenario: Union only selected-slide inspection and direct ET region analysis instructions; no recursive reference loading.
